|access-date=2026-05-02 |work=Forbes |language=en}} == History == Godrej Properties was established in 1990 as the real estate development arm of the [[Godrej Enterprises Group|Godrej Group]], a diversified Indian conglomerate founded in 1897.{{Cite web |date=27 February 2025 |title=Godrej Properties - Hem Securities Research (Analyst Report) |url=https://hemadmin.hemsecurities.com/images/Files/CompanyReports/1165P.pdf |website=Hem Securities Research}} In 2010, the company went public following an [[initial public offering]] that raised approximately US$100 million.{{Cite news |last=Kumar |first=John Satish |date=2010-01-05 |title=Godrej Properties in Robust Debut; Boost for Sector - WSJ |url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/SB126266924947516147 |access-date=2026-05-02 |work=Wall Street Journal |language=en-US |issn=0099-9660}} Since 2012, the company has been led by Executive Chairman [[Pirojsha Adi Godrej]], a fourth-generation member of the [[Godrej family]], who joined the [[Godrej Enterprises Group|Godrej Group]] in 2004.{{Cite web |last=Datta |first=Aveek |date=February 2, 2017 |title=Pirojsha Godrej takes over as Godrej Properties chairman |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/special/pirojsha-godrej-takes-over-as-godrej-properties-chairman/45731/1 |access-date=2026-05-02 |website=Forbes India |language=en}}{{Cite web |last=Nandy |first=Madhurima |date=2024-05-14 |title=How Pirojsha Godrej changed India’s real estate business {{!}} Company Business News |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/how-pirojsha-godrej-changed-india-s-real-estate-business-11715681214765.html |access-date=2026-05-02 |website=mint |language=en}} Over the years, the company has developed residential, commercial, and township projects across multiple cities in India, including the [[Mumbai Metropolitan Region]] and Pune. In 2025, the company acquired approximately 75 acres of land in [[Nagpur]] for the development of a plotted township project.{{Cite news |last=Mishra |first=Lalatendu |date=2025-11-21 |title=Godrej Properties buys 75 acres land in Nagpur for plotted township project |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/godrej-properties-buys-75-acres-land-in-nagpur-for-plotted-township-project/article70306031.ece |access-date=2026-05-02 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}} In 2026, it acquired an 8.5-acre land parcel in [[Mahalunge]], Pune, through an outright purchase.{{Cite web |last=Kumar |first=Chitranjan |date=2026-01-30 |title=Godrej Properties acquires 8.5 acre Pune land with ₹2,000 crore revenue potential |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/business-news/godrej-properties-acquires-85-acre-pune-land-with-2000-crore-revenue-potential/129909 |access-date=2026-05-02 |website=Fortune India |language=en}} == Operations == The company operates in 12 cities across India, including the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), Delhi-NCR, Pune, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad. In 2025, GPL reported sales bookings of ₹34,171 crore.{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2026-01-15 |title=Godrej Properties retains top spot in Indian residential real estate market |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/real-estate/godrej-properties-retains-top-spot-in-indian-residential-real-estate-market/article70512515.ece |access-date=2026-05-02 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} In February 2026, the company announced a joint development agreement for an 18-acre land parcel in Thane, within the [[Mumbai Metropolitan Region]] (MMR).{{Cite web |last=R Thakkar |first=Mehul |date=2026-02-23 |title=Godrej Properties signs JDA for 18-acre Thane project with ₹7,500 crore revenue potential |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/real-estate/godrej-properties-inks-jda-for-18-acres-of-land-in-thane-near-mumbai-with-revenue-potential-of-rs-7-500-crore-101771822752933.html |access-date=2026-05-02 |website=Hindustan Times |language=en}} == Capital raising == In June 2018, GPL raised ₹1,000 crore through a private placement,{{Cite news |last=Babar |first=Kailash |date=2021-09-30 |title=Godrej Properties inks redevelopment pact for 7.5-acre project in Mumbai’s Wadala |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/property-/-cstruction/godrej-properties-inks-redevelopment-pact-for-7-5-acre-project-in-mumbais-wadala/articleshow/86603964.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2026-05-02 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} followed by ₹2,100 crore through a [[Qualified institutional placement]] (QIP) in 2019 and ₹3,750 crore through another QIP to institutional in March 2021. In December 2024, the company raised ₹6,000 crore through a further QIP.{{Cite web |last=Bhutra |first=Sonal |last2=Fatakia |first2=Hormaz |date=2024-10-01 |title=Godrej Properties approves ₹6,000 crore fund raise through various methods - CNBC TV18 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/godrej-properties-share-price-6000-crore-fund-raise-qip-fpo-tranches-q1-net-debt-guidance-19485425.htm |access-date=2026-05-02 |website=CNBCTV18 |language=en}} == Projects == * [[Godrej BKC]], Mumbai * [[Planet Godrej]], Mahalaxmi, Mumbai * Godrej Garden City, Ahmedabad{{cite news |title=Godrej township in Ahmedabad to have more residential space |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/ahmedabad/godrej-township-in-ahmedabad-to-have-more-residential-space/ |work=The Indian Express |date=6 December 2009 |language=en}}{{cite news |title=Godrej Properties sells over 1 mn sq-ft in new launch at Godrej Garden City in Ahmedabad - Construction Week India |url=https://www.constructionweekonline.in/business/godrej-properties-sells-over-1-mn-sq-ft-in-new-launch-at-godrej-garden-city-in-ahmedabad |work=Construction Week India |date=5 January 2023}} * Godrej City, Panvel, Maharashtra{{cite news |last1=Ramachandran |first1=Naman |title=India’s Godrej Fund Management Signs $236 Million Studio Deal With Maharashtra Government at WAVES Summit |url=https://variety.com/2025/film/news/india-godrej-236-million-studio-deal-maharashtra-waves-1236386312/ |work=Variety |date=4 May 2025}} * The Trees, Mumbai{{cite news |last1=Staff |first1=A. extract: Godrej Properties Limited is an Indian real estate company headquartered in Mumbai. A subsidiary of Godrej Industries Group, it operates in the residential, commercial, and township development sectors across major Indian cities. The company is listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and the National Stock Exchange (NSE).
